text: The first proper job I had was working as a waiter in a small family café near my university when I was nineteen. I found it quite by chance, actually. A friend of mine mentioned that they were short-staffed, so I dropped in with my CV, and the owner offered me a trial shift on the spot.

My duties were fairly straightforward on paper: taking orders, carrying dishes and clearing tables. In practice, though, it was much more demanding than I'd expected. On busy weekends there'd be a queue out of the door, and I had to remember who ordered what while keeping a smile on my face. I made plenty of mistakes in the beginning, like mixing up orders, but the other staff were very supportive, and within a month I felt much more at ease. The owner was a very kind woman who taught me how to make coffee properly, and I'm still quite proud of that skill.

Looking back, I think it taught me more than some of my university courses. I learnt how to stay calm under pressure and how to deal with difficult customers without taking it personally. It also gave me a real appreciation for people who work in service jobs, as I'd never realised how physically exhausting they are. Perhaps most importantly, earning my own money made me far more responsible about spending, and I still draw on those lessons today.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: The first proper job I had was working as a waiter in a small family café near my university

tips.en: The 'on paper' versus 'in practice' contrast creates interest and depth.
tips.kk: «Қағаз жүзінде» мен «іс жүзінде» қарама-қайшылығы қызығушылық пен тереңдік тудырады.
tips.ru: Контраст «на бумаге» и «на практике» создаёт интерес и глубину.
tips.example: On busy weekends there'd be a queue out of the door

tips.en: A specific skill with an explanation answers the 'what you learnt' bullet.
tips.kk: Түсіндірмесі бар нақты дағды «and explain what you learnt» тармағына жауап береді.
tips.ru: Конкретный навык с пояснением отвечает на пункт «and explain what you learnt».
tips.example: I learnt how to stay calm under pressure

note.en: Introduction: what the job was and how you got it.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бұл қандай жұмыс және оны қалай таптыңыз.
note.ru: Вступление: что за работа и как вы её получили.

note.en: Body: duties and the real difficulties of the job.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: міндеттер және жұмыстың нақты қиындықтары.
note.ru: Основная часть: обязанности и реальные трудности работы.

note.en: Conclusion: what you learnt, as a reflection looking back.
note.ru: Заключение: чему вы научились — размышление «оглядываясь назад».
